title: Base change of a flat module is flat
statement: Let $R\to R'$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $M$ a flat $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Then $R'\otimes_RM$, an $R'$-module through the first factor, is a flat $R'$-module.
